bio: Mary Gardner was born Mary Warren, a daughter of Thomas Warren of Southwold. Widowed by her first husband, a Gardner, she became the third wife of Rev. John Youngs, probably marrying him at Salem about 1639. She died at Southold in 1678. She is connected to the family by marriage only and is not one of John's ancestors.
sources: [R4-S1] Selah Youngs Jr., Youngs Family: Vicar Christopher Yonges, his ancestors in England and his descendants in America (1907), pp. 38-41 (First and Second Generations) (secondary) https://archive.org/details/youngsfamilyvica00youn
